name: Stapled booklet (saddle stitch)
blurb: Sheets folded in half, nested, stapled through the fold. 8 to 24 pages, A5 on A4. Only the centre spread is on one sheet: split pairs elsewhere can drift.

steps.text: Print both sides, flip on SHORT edge, scaling off. One sheet per 4 pages.
If trimmed: cut each sheet at the top and bottom trim marks.
Fold every sheet in half along the centre, printed page numbers outward, crease hard.
Nest the folded sheets inside each other in order: sheet 1 outside, the last sheet in the middle.
Staple twice through the fold from the outside (long-arm stapler), or sew a 3-hole pamphlet stitch with thread.
Optional: trim the open edge straight; inner pages stick out a little on thicker booklets.
